title: Walk without spilling
situation: A brim-full cup carried through a turn, a stop and a restart. The hand follows a smoothed guide path rather than the bobbing chest, so the arm absorbs the walk. The spill check measures the cup's horizontal jerk every frame.
success_observation: Cardboard cut-out skin applied to 3D Bolas motion bank joints.
